name: SilkGradient
description: A raw WebGL satin shader: a warped multi-sine height field is lit per pixel with diffuse shading, a tight specular highlight and a broad sheen lobe, so dark fabric folds ripple and catch light. Falls back to blurred, skewing CSS fold bands when WebGL is unavailable.
a11yNotes: The canvas (or CSS fallback) is an aria-hidden decorative layer; children render above with light, shadowed text. Animation stops off-screen, at speed 0, and under prefers-reduced-motion (one static frame). GL resources are deleted on unmount and a lost context switches to the CSS fallback.

propsApi.name: color2
propsApi.description: Secondary fabric color blended across the folds (hex).

propsApi.name: highlightColor
propsApi.description: Specular sheen color on the fold crests (hex).

propsApi.name: backgroundColor
propsApi.description: Shadow color deep in the folds (hex).

propsApi.name: foldScale
propsApi.description: Size of the folds; higher = broader, softer drapes (0.3–3).

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.
